page.content:
Molitor was a Planet in the Known Universe. It was the location of Battle of Molitor. Following the battle, the Fremen Fedaykin held a feast in celebration. The nights of the planet were cold.

page.overview:
What is Molitor?

Molitor was a Planet in the Known Universe. It was the location of Battle of Molitor. Following the battle, the Fremen Fedaykin held a feast in celebration. The nights of the planet were cold.
